name: design
prompt: Dark deep-sea 3D game, near-black water with drifting marine snow, warm sepia and gold light, film grain: a small glowing golden jellyfish made of points of light swims between giant translucent jellyfish whose bells are made of moving black-and-white archive film footage, flickering sepia images of hands, a door and a dog. It swims into one of the giant bells and the old film unspools around it as a long corridor of glowing frames that trail behind it like a worm of time. Chase camera behind the small jellyfish, slow and smooth.

arguments.text: deep underwater ambience, slow muffled currents, distant whale-like hum, soft bubbles, calm and dark
an old film projector starting up, the reel spinning up and the shutter clattering into rhythm, warm and mechanical
a single soft camera shutter click followed by a small glass chime ringing out
rising underwater whoosh with bubbles, gently breaking out into open water
steady 16mm film projector running, soft rhythmic clatter of the shutter and the reel

name: music_ocean
prompt: slow ambient score for a dark deep-sea dream: warm analog pads, a soft heartbeat pulse at 96 bpm, distant glass bells, tape hiss and gentle film-projector texture, melancholy and luminous, no drums, no vocals
